canopy-green.$description: Canopy Green — Hero canvas, dark section backgrounds, primary heading color on light backgrounds — establishes the dominant brand surface

coral-pulse.$description: Coral Pulse — Primary action buttons, filled CTAs — the only warm high-saturation color in the system, creates urgency without aggression

indigo-bloom.$description: Indigo Bloom — Toolkit section background overlay, secondary brand headings — anchors the purple-lavender pastel system

leaf-bright.$description: Leaf Bright — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Blue outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

orchid-tint.$description: Orchid Tint — Decorative pink accent for badges, tag chips, and pink-section heading underlines

sky-signal.$description: Sky Signal — Cyan accent for icons, chart lines, and notification-style data visualization inside cards

aubergine.$description: Aubergine — Muted plum for body text on lavender backgrounds and plum-section headings — warm dark that pairs with #460095

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary body text, borders, icon strokes — used aggressively for 1px dividers and outline icon set

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, text on dark backgrounds, nav background, white phone-mockup surfaces

ash.$description: Ash — Mid-gray for secondary borders, placeholder text, disabled list items, icon strokes at reduced weight

slate.$description: Slate — Body meta text, subtle list dividers, caption-tier typography

graphite.$description: Graphite — Strong secondary text, icon strokes at full opacity, dark borders on light pastel cards

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Headlines on white/pastel surfaces, link text color when not using brand purple

frost-gray.$description: Frost Gray — Hairline dividers, subtle card separators on white sections

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Neutral card surface when no pastel is appropriate, footer background, table stripes

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Dominant page background canvas — the near-gray violet that sets the overall atmospheric tint of the site

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Green-tinted card and section background, pale green data viz fills

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Pale cyan card backgrounds, cooling counterpoint to the warm greens and corals

sage-wash.$description: Sage Wash — Very pale green card surface, lighter than Mint Wash for secondary cards

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Pale lavender card background, pink-adjacent pastel

peach-wash.$description: Peach Wash — Soft section background, alternate surface, and quiet card fill. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cream.$description: Cream — Warm cream card background, editorial yellow-tinted sections

sand.$description: Sand — Warm beige background variant, rarely used neutral surface

dm-sans.$description: Single-family system — display headlines at 69–116px weight 500–600 with tight tracking create the editorial feel; body at 16–18px weight 400; UI at 14–16px weight 500–600. The same font handles 12px captions through 116px display, which is the signature: one voice, enormous dynamic range. The ss03 stylistic set is enabled site-wide.
